research_question: Owner-approved addition: 7 Best Legal Calendaring Software Options for Law Firms. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for legal calendaring software, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Law firm owners, legal operations staff, and legal teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; DocketCalendar pricing corrected from $15 per court and $15 per calendar to $20 per court and $20 per user, and rule sets from 1,800+ to about 2,200; LawToolBox monthly-billing figure and CalendarRules Canada and Clio claims cut as not shown on the pages; CourtAlert ethical-wall claim cut.
